end.summary: Ordered BCE and CE dates correctly on a timeline in 3 unaided attempts.
end.parentNote: Asha practised BCE/CE ordering, decades, centuries, millennia, and identifying historical sources. Aarav used the rule that BCE numbers count down and correctly placed 1947 CE in the 20th century; they also explained that archaeological remains can show past food practices. Aarav initially suggested that books were the only source and that an inscription must tell the whole truth; this was corrected later by discussing what evidence can and cannot show. At home, practise sorting mixed BCE/CE dates and discuss what one object can show—and what it cannot prove—about the past.
